name: My Ex-Future Family
source:
Starting a new life? You took it a little too far.

You're 23, and an accident has turned your own past into a mystery. You'll have to get to know life all over again. Luckily, getting to know people can be a pleasure. Especially with so many interesting women around.

But each woman calls for a different approach. Charm or cheek? Genuine interest or a carefully calculated game? Being a good guy feels nice. Being bad sometimes feels even better. Either way, the consequences are yours to deal with.

Welcome to My Ex-Future Family, an adult visual novel about tangled relationships, desires, and decisions you'll have to live with.

First, get acquainted. Then, make it complicated.

Flirt, get to know the women, and decide how far you're willing to go for their attention. Young women and mature women, different personalities and different desires: there's no one-size-fits-all approach.

You can earn their trust. You can scheme and manipulate. Or you can play the story again and see where a different approach takes you.

Between the romance, humor, and explicit scenes, there's room for plot twists. And assignments from the college dean. Yes, you've got plenty on your plate.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2134860]Steam[/url]]
